'''Chris Denoma''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Endor Regionals]] on 1 July 2000 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|RTP/Attack Run]], according to Jeremy LaMere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d982">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-05-endor-regional-seattle-wa-7-1-2000d982/ endor-regional-seattle-wa-7-1-2000], DeckTech (Jeremy "jerome" LaMere, 5 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-05-endor-regional-seattle-wa-7-1-2000d982/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
